intro.uz: Zarina birinchi ish suhbatidan keyin blogiga yozadi. Oʻqishdan oldin: ish suhbatida qanday savollar berilishi mumkin?

paragraphs.en: Today I had my first job interview! I want to be a tour guide, and a small travel company in Samarkand needs a new guide for English-speaking tourists. The interview was at ten o'clock this morning.
paragraphs.uz: Bugun birinchi ish suhbatimga bordim! Men gid boʻlishni xohlayman, Samarqanddagi kichik sayyohlik kompaniyasiga esa ingliz tilida soʻzlashuvchi sayyohlar uchun yangi gid kerak. Suhbat bugun ertalab soat oʻnda boʻldi.

paragraphs.en: I was very nervous. I woke up at six and I couldn't eat breakfast. I put on my best white shirt and took a taxi, because I didn't want to be late. I arrived twenty minutes early.
paragraphs.uz: Juda hayajonlandim. Soat oltida uygʻondim va nonushta qila olmadim. Eng yaxshi oq koʻylagimni kiydim va taksiga oʻtirdim, chunki kechikishni istamadim. Yigirma daqiqa erta yetib keldim.

paragraphs.en: There were two people at the interview: the manager and an older guide. First, they asked me questions in Uzbek. Then the guide started to speak English, and I had to tell them about the Registan. I think I did it well, because they smiled a lot.
paragraphs.uz: Suhbatda ikki kishi bor edi: menejer va yoshi kattaroq bir gid. Avval ular menga oʻzbek tilida savollar berishdi. Keyin gid inglizcha gapira boshladi va men ularga Registon haqida gapirib berishim kerak edi. Menimcha, yaxshi uddaladim, chunki ular koʻp jilmayishdi.

paragraphs.en: They also asked me a difficult question: "What will you do if a tourist gets lost?" I answered, "I will phone the tourist and wait at the meeting place." I'm not sure it was the best answer.
paragraphs.uz: Ular yana bir qiyin savol ham berishdi: «Agar sayyoh adashib qolsa, nima qilasiz?» Men: «Sayyohga qoʻngʻiroq qilaman va uchrashuv joyida kutaman», — deb javob berdim. Bu eng yaxshi javob boʻldimi, bilmayman.

paragraphs.en: The manager said, "We are going to call you on Friday." I haven't heard anything yet, of course, but I feel hopeful. If I get the job, I will start in June. Wish me luck!
paragraphs.uz: Menejer: «Juma kuni sizga qoʻngʻiroq qilamiz», — dedi. Albatta, hali hech narsa eshitmadim, lekin umidim bor. Agar ishga olishsa, iyunda ish boshlayman. Menga omad tilang!
